tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250mgon po tshogs bdag gi mjug chog bzhugs so// 1$0000300

mgon po tshogs bdag gi sgrub pa'i las rim thams cad tshar nas/ mthar thug dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab pa ni/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri bā ra arghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs mgon po bstan pa'i dpal// tshogs bdag dgyes pa'i byin rlabs las// sdug bsngal nad sel thugs rje che// thams cad sprul pa'i cho 'phrul dpal// tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag po ste// de bzhin gshegs pas bzhed pa ston/ khams gsum khengs pa'i sems can rnams// tshe dang srog la dbang ba ste// shes rab mtshon gyis sgyu mar ston// blun rmongs khengs pa thal bar mdzod// mi mthun phyogs rnams zad par ston// byang chub chen por khyed kyis sgrol// dpal gyi snying po dpal phreng ma// dpal gyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ de nas tshogs kyi bdag po'i bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ mgon po 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol// mgon po'i dkyil 'khor sgor zhugs nas// bdag ni ma rig lus ngag sems// nongs pa thams cad bzod par gsol// dam tshig gnyan po bsrung rgyu la// bka' ltar ma gyur rngo ma thogs// bsnyen sgrub phud dang gtor ma chag /rtsa ba yan lag nyams chag kun// mgon po'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// bstan srung mthu yi dngos grub stsol// yi dam rtse gcig bsgom rgyu la// ting 'dzin ma gsal nog par bskyed// bstan srung tshogs la bzod par gsol// bdag gis ma tshor nyams srid pas// phyin chad khyed kyis bzod par gsol// bskang ngo bshags so bzod par gsol// mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// bskul zhing dad cing mos pa'i tshe// ma g.yel las rnams myur du 'grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sro thog rgyal ba'i dben gnas su chu mo glang lo'i nyer bdun la ldi ri chos kyi grags pas yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so// de nas bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐/ bdag gis mgon po khyed bsgrubs byin rlabs kyis// bstan pa bshigs pa'i dgra dpung 'joms par shog

/dam nyams dgra bo las ngan sdig can gyis// phyi nang gsang gsum sgrub pa'i mtshams bkral sogs// gdug sems can rnams myur du sgrol nas kyang*// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /gzhan yang stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten du// mu ge nad yams god kha med par shog /lha dang mi yi longs spyod dpal 'byor rnams// nyi zla lta bur kun tu rgyas par shog /rnam par sbyangs pa'i shes rab thob par shog /bde ba'i don rtogs 'gro ba'i skyabs gyur shog /dngos grub mchog thob 'phags pa'i zhal mthong nas// las kyi don rtogs 'gro ba'i mgon gyur shog / maṅga laṃ// bha bantu/ // /
